key_highlights: ASX logged its third consecutive week of gains, driven by strong momentum in mining and technology equities.
Australian unemployment jumped to a 5-year high, abruptly cooling RBA rate hike expectations while putting downward pressure on the AUD.
The RBA faces a stagflationary dilemma between weakening employment metrics and persistently elevated inflation.
Commodity sector exhibits divergence: gold and lithium juniors report operational expansion, while high-cost junior iron ore miners face squeeze.
Property auction markets in Sydney show severe softness, increasing medium-term risk for bank mortgage portfolios.

sectors.trend: Gold exploration traction and lithium scaling contrast with intensifying margin pressure on junior iron ore miners.
sectors.implications: Favour tier-1 low-cost diversified producers and low-cost gold miners over high-cost junior bulk operators.

sectors.trend: Deteriorating labour data ends RBA cash rate hike bets, but rising mortgage vulnerability threatens asset quality.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin expansion caps are in place; downside risk to loan books and credit growth increases for major banks.

sectors.trend: Domestic east coast gas shortages escalate structural price pressures, while overseas geopolitical drone attacks highlight energy security.
sectors.implications: Upstream domestic gas producers benefit from high realized domestic pricing, raising input costs for heavy industry.

sectors.trend: Tech equities rally in tandem with easing bond yields following weak macro jobs data.
sectors.implications: Valuation relief and multiple expansion for quality growth names as terminal rate expectations moderate.

sectors.trend: Consumer capacity is strained by cost-of-living issues, fleet rationalisations, and corporate governance scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Maintain defensive positioning; discretionary spending and brand value remain exposed to household budget compression.

sectors.trend: Sydney residential auction clearance drops significantly, contrasting with high-profile trophy retail acquisitions.
sectors.implications: Residential developers and housing-exposed funds face downward pressure; focus on prime cash-flow resilient commercial assets.

key_themes: Macro Shift: Unemployment spike to five-year high removes immediate RBA hike risk and softens terminal cash rate expectations.
Currency Realignment: Weaker AUD/USD boosts offshore earnings for major miners while increasing imported inflation costs.
Global Competition Risks: 'China Shock 2.0' poses deflationary manufactured goods export pressures and structural challenges.
Housing Market Vulnerability: Auction weakness and mortgage stress introduce risks to domestic credit expansion.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight cyclical consumer discretionary stocks; tilt toward defensive healthcare and gold producers.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Residential Housing Market Correction & Bank Credit Impairment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce overweights in domestic retail banks; tilt towards diversified financials and liquid cash instruments.
Focus mining holdings in lowest-quartile cost producers with robust balance sheets and capital discipline.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: East Coast Domestic Gas Market Deficit
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight upstream domestic energy operators; avoid energy-intensive industrial companies lacking long-term gas hedges.

opportunities.rationale: Strong operational momentum, high global gold prices, and a weaker AUD provide substantial cash flow leverage.
Falling bond yield expectations provide immediate valuation support for quality SaaS and technology leaders.
Severe structural shortfalls in the east coast gas market guarantee elevated uncontracted realization prices.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Major Domestic Retail Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: A 5-year high in unemployment combined with falling auction clearances elevates mortgage credit risk and limits loan growth.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Exit High-Cost Junior Iron Ore Explorers
defensive_moves.rationale: High operating costs and supply adjustments squeeze junior miners lacking low-cost infrastructure.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Discretionary Retail and Vulnerable Corporates
defensive_moves.rationale: Household budgetary strain and rising governance concerns compress retail margins.

market_outlook.short_term: The ASX 200 is set to consolidate around current levels; rate hike relief will support tech and defensive equities, while banks and bulk miners face margin pressure.
market_outlook.long_term: A bifurcated market: resource producers with AUD-earning advantages will outperform domestic cyclical sectors constrained by elevated household debt and labour slack.
